method: 200 fine kernels per GPU, exactly 50 within NVTX minimax_h3.denoise.step_03; select its first layer (layer0). QKV=last6 preceding barriers; O=next2/8 barriers. Optimized endpoint from containing NVTX and correlated GPU kernels/copies, including final output assembly; baseline endpoint from first GEMM after final O barrier, inferred out_proj from model source order. RDMA windows are barrier interiors; percentages are raw individual GPU Metrics samples, not interval averages. Compute overlap counts kernels only. Profiling timings are not unprofiled latency claims.
